mail.templates_scope_notice: This list holds the emails of modules that run on the new system. Emails of modules still on Perfex are edited in Perfex's Email Templates.
mail.disable_all_title: {count, plural, one {Stop sending {countN} {module} email?} other {Stop sending {countN} {module} emails?}}
mail.disable_all_body: No email from these templates is sent until they are switched on again. Emails already sent are not affected.
mail.enabled_many_toast: {count, plural, one {{countN} template enabled} other {{countN} templates enabled}}
mail.disabled_many_toast: {count, plural, one {{countN} template disabled} other {{countN} templates disabled}}
mail.templates_empty_body: Templates appear here when a module that sends email moves to the new system.
mail.message_helper: Plain text. A blank line starts a new paragraph. Merge fields are replaced with the record's values when the email is sent.
mail.preview_sample_caption: Sample data, and links don't open here. Real emails use the record's values.
mail.preview_fallback: Recipients who use {language} get the English version.
mail.preview_empty: Nothing to preview yet. Write the email message to see it here.
mail.preview_failed: We couldn't show the preview. Try again.
mail.send_test_caption: Sends the {language} version shown above, with sample data and unsaved changes, to <bdi>{email}</bdi>.
mail.send_test_status_caption: Sends a short test email to <bdi>{email}</bdi>, your address.
mail.test_retrying: Test email not sent yet. Trying again at {time}.
mail.test_waiting: Waiting: the mail server isn't answering. The test is sent when it answers.
mail.test_not_configured: Email isn't configured for this system, so tests can't be sent.
mail.test_no_address: Your account has no email address, so tests can't be sent to you.

failure_reason.recipient_refused: The mail server refused the recipient's address.
failure_reason.auth_failed: The mail server refused the system's sign-in. The mail settings need checking.
failure_reason.server_unreachable: The mail server couldn't be reached.
failure_reason.timeout: The mail server took too long to answer.
failure_reason.message_refused: The mail server refused the email.
failure_reason.not_configured: Email isn't configured for this system.
failure_reason.record_gone: The record this email was about no longer exists.
failure_reason.template_off: The template was switched off before the email was sent.
failure_reason.unknown: The email couldn't be sent for a reason we don't recognise.

mail.formatting_dropped: This wording had formatting in Perfex. It was kept as text and the formatting was dropped.
mail.template_undefined_notice: This email's module no longer defines it, so it can't be edited or sent.
mail.active_helper: When this is off, this email is not sent.
mail.english_version_helper: Required. Recipients whose language has no version get this one.
mail.other_version_helper: Optional. When it's empty, recipients who use {language} get the English version.
mail.version_pair: Fill in both the subject and the message, or leave both empty.
mail.unknown_merge_field: {token} isn't a merge field of this template. Use Insert merge field to pick one.
mail.long_dash: Replace the long dash with a hyphen, a comma or a colon.
mail.body_not_kept: The email's content isn't kept. Only who it was sent to, when, and the result are recorded.
mail.retention_caption: Entries older than {months} months are removed.
mail.log_empty_body: Emails the new system sends appear here with their status.
mail.resend_body: It's sent again with the template's current wording and the record's current values. This entry stays in the log as it is.
mail.sent_email_not_found: This sent email no longer exists.
mail.not_configured_notice: Email isn't configured for this system, so the new system sends no email. Setting it up is part of the deployment: ask the person who deploys the system.
mail.paused_notice: The mail server isn't answering, so sending is paused. Emails wait and are sent when it answers again.
mail.server_not_answering: {time, select, none {Not answering, sending is paused} other {Not answering, sending is paused since {time}}}
mail.deployment_caption: These settings are part of the system's deployment and can't be changed here. Perfex's own emails use Perfex's SMTP Settings.

errors.ERP-CORE-0004: This email template no longer exists.
errors.ERP-MAIL-0002: Email isn't configured for this system, so nothing can be sent. Ask the person who deploys the system to set it up.
errors.ERP-MAIL-0003: This email template was changed by someone else since you opened it.
errors.ERP-MAIL-0004: This template is switched off, so the email can't be resent. Switch the template on first.
errors.ERP-MAIL-0005: The record this email was about no longer exists, so the email can't be resent.
errors.ERP-MAIL-0006: This email is still waiting to be sent, so it can't be resent yet.
errors.ERP-MAIL-0007: You've sent several test emails in a short time. Try again {seconds, select, none {in a moment} other {in {seconds} seconds}}.
errors.ERP-MAIL-0008: A test email can't be resent. Send a new test instead.
